description: This file defines the abstract class AnyKeyboard, which extends Keyboard and represents a customizable keyboard layout for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes nested classes for keys and generic row keyboards, manages keyboard states, key creation from XML, and layout adjustments. It also references various external resources, classes, and methods related to keyboard behavior, styling, and configuration.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard
classes.description: An abstract class representing a customizable keyboard layout, managing keys, states, and layout adjustments for the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard.AnyKey
classes.description: A subclass of Keyboard.Key with additional properties and behaviors specific to the AnySoftKeyboard project, including support for tags, genders, skin tones, and custom XML attributes.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard.EnterKey
classes.description: A subclass of AnyKey representing the Enter key with custom enable/disable behavior based on its original height.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard.HardKeyboardAction
classes.description: An interface defining actions for physical keyboard keys, including getting key codes and modifier states.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard.HardKeyboardTranslator
classes.description: An interface for translating physical keyboard input into actions or key codes.

classes.name: AnyKeyboard.GenericRowKeyboard
classes.description: A nested static class extending AnyKeyboard, representing a generic row of keys, mainly used for top or bottom rows.

methods.name: loadKeyboard
methods.description: Loads the keyboard layout, including generic rows and key initialization.

methods.name: fixEdgeFlags
methods.description: Sets edge flags for keys to define their position within rows (top, bottom, left, right).

methods.name: onKeyboardViewWidthChanged
methods.description: Adjusts key sizes and positions when the keyboard view width changes.

methods.name: initKeysMembers
methods.description: Initializes key properties, detects language direction, and manages special keys like domain and language keys.

methods.name: addGenericRows
methods.description: Adds top and bottom generic rows to the keyboard layout.

methods.name: fixKeyboardDueToGenericRow
methods.description: Adjusts key positions and sizes based on added generic rows.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Creates a key object from XML, setting special keys like shift, delete, and enter.

methods.name: createRowFromXml
methods.description: Creates a row of keys from XML and tracks if top or bottom rows are created.

methods.name: setImeOptions
methods.description: Sets the IME options, primarily enabling the enter key.

methods.name: setShiftLocked
methods.description: Locks or unlocks the shift state.

methods.name: isShifted
methods.description: Returns whether the shift is active.

methods.name: setShifted
methods.description: Sets the shift state.

methods.name: keyboardSupportShift
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard supports shift.

methods.name: isShiftLocked
methods.description: Checks if shift is locked.

methods.name: isControl
methods.description: Checks if control is active.

methods.name: setControl
methods.description: Activates or deactivates control.

methods.name: setupKeyAfterCreation
methods.description: Configures additional properties for a key after creation, such as popup resources.

methods.name: getKeyboardName
methods.description: Returns the name of the keyboard.

methods.name: getKeyboardIconResId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID for the keyboard icon.

methods.name: getKeyboardId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the keyboard.

methods.name: getKeyboardMode
methods.description: Returns the current keyboard mode.

methods.name: setCondensedKeys
methods.description: Sets the condense type for keys and recomputes neighbors if changed.
